title_zh: 扫雷的数学：概率推断、必然安全格与 AI 辅助系统的实现
title_en: The Math Behind Minesweeper: Probability Inference, Safe Cell Detection, and Building an AI Assist
desc_zh: 扫雷不是「瞎猜」——它有严格的数学逻辑。这篇文章讲扫雷的概率推断系统：哪些格子是「必然安全」的、哪些是「必然是雷」的、当无法确定时如何计算最优概率选择——以及把这套逻辑做成一个 AI 辅助系统，帮助玩家在卡关时找到突破口。
desc_en: Minesweeper isn't about guessing — it has rigorous mathematical logic. This article covers the probability inference system: which cells are 'definitely safe,' which are 'definitely mines,' and when certainty is impossible, how to calculate optimal probability choices. Then we turn this logic into an AI assist system that finds breakthroughs when players get stuck.
